standard.summary: 按最佳 EMA loss 的比例判断有效下降。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Judges a real fall as a proportion of the best EMA loss.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 按最佳 EMA loss 的比例判断有效下降。默认 0.001 会过滤后期很小的训练 loss 抖动。

advanced_en.principle: Judges meaningful improvement as a proportion of the best EMA loss. The default 0.001 filters out small late-training loss jitter.
